# Configure environment
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake)
set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib)
set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib)
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin)

add_library(JSONAdapterInterface INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(JSONAdapterInterface INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

# Add subprojects
add_subdirectory(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/JSONAdapterTestUtilities)
